# Glimpse Qatar

> Glimpse Qatar is the Doha office of Glimpse Digital Agency, an award-winning digital marketing agency founded in 2016 and named MENA Agency of the Year 2022-2023. From Doha, the team delivers SEO, paid media, social media, influencer marketing, branding, content production, web and augmented reality work in English and Arabic for brands in Qatar and across the GCC.

## Key facts
- Name: Glimpse Digital Agency Qatar (Glimpse Qatar)
- Legal entity: Glimpse Media LLC, incorporated in the Qatar Financial Centre (QFC number 05559), licensed by the Qatar Financial Centre Authority
- Type: Full-service digital marketing agency
- Location: C/O Media City Qatar, Floor No. 16, Tornado Tower, No. 17, Doha, Qatar
- Phone: +974 0000 0000
- Email: hello@theglimpseproject.com
- Website: https://www.theglimpseproject.qa/
- Areas served: Doha, Lusail, Al Rayyan, Al Wakrah and the rest of Qatar, plus the wider GCC through Glimpse's regional offices
- Languages: English and Arabic
- Office hours: Sunday to Thursday, 9:00 to 18:00 (Qatar time)
- Group: Glimpse Digital Agency, headquartered in Dubai, with offices in Qatar, the UAE, Saudi Arabia, France and Lebanon
- Recognition: MENA Agency of the Year 2022-2023
- UAE website (sister site): https://www.theglimpseproject.com/
